title: notes/notes.config.yml — rasa.module.notes (records-family/1)
description: What a project declares to rasa.module.notes. Every key except `schema` is optional and a project with no config file is valid, except that `notes canonize` refuses until `canon_target` is declared. Every list follows declare-to-constrain: absent or [] = free; non-empty = closed.

default_notebook.description: Where `notes new` files a note with no --in. Default: inbox.

journal_notebook.description: Where `notes today` keeps daily notes. Default: journal.

notebooks.description: Declare to constrain: the notebook paths notes may live in.

categories.description: Decision categories. Declared => every decision must carry one of them.

canon_target.description: THE HARD-STOP: where a decision becomes law in this project. `notes canonize` refuses until this is declared.
